content:
ajackson: Heads-up: starting a quiet-window rollout in 15m. Scope: API -> runtime -> router. Console will be pinned to the previous schema during the window.

deploybot: scheduled wave 1 in 15m. plan: api (10%), runtime (25%), router (100%). will report per-wave health. logs -> #release-telemetry

priya: Quick ask — API contract change present in runtime build? I thought console pin was to avoid header-shim mismatch.

linh: yes, runtime includes a small header-split for trace-propagation. Console still expects old header ordering. that's why we pin console to v2.3.3 for the window.

sasha: ops: set alert thresholds please. If client 5xx > 3% for 3m during any wave, we rollback that wave. confirm? :warning:

tom: Agree on rollback threshold. Add latency SLO trip: p95 > 600ms sustained 5m -> pause and investigate before proceeding.

ajackson: Owners: api -> priya, runtime -> linh, router -> tom, console pin -> sasha. Deploybot will auto-advance unless a manual hold reaction from owner.

deploybot: note: auto-rollback hook enabled. command if triggered: `deployctl rollback --scope <service> --to-tag stable-2026-03-01` (ops only)

priya: I see a small schema delta in api that affects a routing header name. I'll push a compatibility shim to API (non-breaking) in 10m. Will post commit hash when pushed.

linh: runtime kv eviction tweak remains off by default in this wave. we can flip on in next patch. avoids cold-start noise during rollout.

sasha: console pinned to stable. Confirmed: traffic steer will keep 10% to new API on wave1. If errors spike, steer back to 0 and unpin console after stabilization.

tom: router note: I'm going to apply a temporary route override to prefer eu region fallback for caller services with low tolerance. I'll push the change 5m before wave2.

ajackson: Release notes: short blurb only in console changelog: "Performance updates and header-routing improvements; temporary console pin for compatibility during rollout." Keep public details minimal.

deploybot: wave1 complete: api health ok, errors 0.8%. advancing to wave2 in 90s. reporting channel: #release-telemetry

priya: commit pushed: abcdef1 - compatibility shim. @linh can you confirm runtime reads both header variants?

linh: checked locally against abcdef1, runtime accepts both header names. rolling with it.

sasha: putting a manual hold now because p95 jumped to 640ms for a minute. investigating logs. :mag:

deploybot: hold acknowledged by sasha. pausing wave progression. current wave: runtime.

tom: I'll roll router override back while we look. command I ran: `routerctl revert --name temp-eu-fallback` — monitoring

ajackson: Good catch. If we need to rollback runtime: target tag stable-2026-02-28. Priya/Linh coordinate and ping when ready to resume.

linh: rolling back a quick config tweak now; will post status in 60s.

sasha: metrics stabilizing. p95 down to 420ms and errors 0.9%. recommend resume in 2m. :thumbsup:

priya: ready to resume. we keep console pinned until full router + runtime steady for 20m.

ajackson: Resume approved. Deploybot proceeding to wave3 (router) in 30s. thanks everyone for quick triage.

deploybot: wave3 started. final health stream -> #release-telemetry. will auto-close thread after 1hr if no regressions.

sasha: leaving a note for postmortem: investigate header ordering latency interaction; low priority but document for next rollout.

ajackson: postflight checklist: update release notes, unpin console only after 20m steady, create a small eval to ensure header shim covered. closing coordination here unless something pops up. :white_check_mark:
